auction_registrations_preemption_rank.name: auction_registrations_preemption_rank
auction_registrations_preemption_rank.value:
("auction_registrations"."is_preemption_holder" AND "auction_registrations"."preemption_rank" IS NOT NULL AND "auction_registrations"."preemption_rank" > 0)
        OR (NOT "auction_registrations"."is_preemption_holder" AND "auction_registrations"."preemption_rank" IS NULL)

auction_registrations_approval.name: auction_registrations_approval
auction_registrations_approval.value: "auction_registrations"."status" <> 'APPROVED' OR ("auction_registrations"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "auction_registrations"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)

auctions_ascending_fields.name: auctions_ascending_fields
auctions_ascending_fields.value: "auctions"."type" <> 'ASCENDING' OR ("auctions"."bid_increment_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "auctions"."bid_increment_cents" > 0 AND "auctions"."ends_at" IS NOT NULL)

auctions_descending_fields.name: auctions_descending_fields
auctions_descending_fields.value:
"auctions"."type" <> 'DESCENDING' OR (
        "auctions"."price_decrement_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "auctions"."price_decrement_cents" > 0
        AND "auctions"."floor_price_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "auctions"."floor_price_cents" > 0
        AND "auctions"."floor_price_cents" <= "auctions"."starting_price_cents"
        AND "auctions"."step_duration_sec" IS NOT NULL AND "auctions"."step_duration_sec" > 0
        AND ("auctions"."switch_to_ascending_on_accept" = false OR ("auctions"."bid_increment_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "auctions"."bid_increment_cents" > 0))
      )

bidder_profiles_company_fields.name: bidder_profiles_company_fields
bidder_profiles_company_fields.value: "bidder_profiles"."type" <> 'COMPANY' OR ("bidder_profiles"."company_name" IS NOT NULL AND "bidder_profiles"."company_reg_no" IS NOT NULL AND "bidder_profiles"."representative_name" IS NOT NULL)
